title: Kusanagi Nene — Dazzling Dream Stage〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I went to SEKAI, saw this weird ball that I thought was a part of some prank, picked it up and ended up here...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This place... It looks a lot like Broadway...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I see a ceiling... There's a spotlight illuminating the entire city too... Hold on, I think this is supposed to be Times Square...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I... I still don't really know what's going on, but I'm here and that's a fact.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I guess I should take a look around.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wow, it's like a real city...
Oh, I've seen this theatre on TV before...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm? But I don't recognize the one next to it. I wonder what's playing there...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
And what's with this poster?
It's pretty much just a giant picture of Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... SEKAI was initially born out mostly of Tsukasa's feelings, so is this an extension of that...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I was the lead for our Christmas show and the Little Mermaid...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Shouldn't those be here too...
Lemme see...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There we go. The Christmas show, that Halloween show we did and the Little Mermaid.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
This is so cool...
Posters of me on Broadway...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hang on, none of this is real.
What am I getting all worked up for...?

<Don't look down. Look up at the sky.
See? There's a beautiful rainbow!>

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line: <Would you like to fly into the sky with me?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I knew it. It's me when I was little rehearsing for that show...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But this video's supposed to be at my house... So what, anything goes at this point?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Still, this reminds me of that Christmas show we did...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm gonna sing my heart out no matter what. I'm not gonna worry so much about trying not to mess up or beating Sakurako...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have Tsukasa, Emu, Rui, Miku and everyone else to thank for making me realize that...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka's Voice
rows.Line: <Most others laughed at me when I told them about how I wanted to do shows around the world, but this troupe didn't.>

rows.Speaker: Yuka's Voice
rows.Line: <Which is why leaving them was so hard...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What happened...?
Why is this playing now?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I...
I can't do anything without...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Ah, Nene, it's you. I was wondering if someone had come by. But what are you doing here so late?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What you found was likely a fragment of somebody's feelings...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, you see... In SEKAI, fragments of feelings that are yet to manifest as a SEKAI of their own can appear here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: By approaching it, you're able to access some of the feelings that are stored inside.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see. So it wasn't a prank or anything.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Based on where I was and what I saw, I'm inclined to believe that those were my feelings...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Um, Nene.
I'd like to ask you a question.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's purely hypothetical but founded on that fragment coming from your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A part of you is happy about how much you've grown and appreciated everything everyone in Wonderlands×Showtime has done for you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Another part of you still dreams of becoming a globe-trotting actress just like your hero.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And there's a part of you that doesn't want to leave your friends behind.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You felt all these things while over there, yes?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I believe you experienced what you did because your mind isn't made up yet.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: To be fair, I didn't actually feel what you felt, so I can't exactly say for sure...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But that's my guess based on what you told me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Would it be better for me in terms of acting to be able to make quicker decisions...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Doubt and hesitation are both evidence of a person trying to face what they're feeling.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's just another way to move forward...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Also, Nene, I don't want you to regret making any decisions.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: My guess is that what you're feeling in your heart right now is going to play an incredibly important role in your life from here on out.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So I believe you should think long and hard about which path you ultimately wish to take.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And I'll be there to help you every step of the way♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I promise to do just that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My dream in life versus wanting to grow alongside Tsukasa, Emu and Rui...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Making a decision won't be easy...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I want to find the right answer and be able to say it without hesitating.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I don't think you have anything to worry about, Nene. I'm sure you'll find the answer you're looking for.
